cover.coreProposition: Bounded execution should follow lifecycle ownership beyond the direct process: an invocation-owned process domain, shared timeout and cancellation teardown, and bounded cleanup can close the demonstrated descendant and pipe hang, while terminal evidence must remain narrower than claims about escaped descendants, non-POSIX trees or external effects.
cover.visualMetaphor: A single tether encloses a branching cluster while one escaped spark remains beyond the boundary
cover.semanticObject: A bounded invocation domain containing a parent and descendants with a visible terminal perimeter
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover emphasizing ownership scope and a bounded shutdown frontier
